scope: UI-187, ART-04: short tooltip forms of every character ability, base game and expansions, by ability id; a key '<card id>#<ability id>' gives one card its own form where the same ability reads differently on another card. Each summarises the printed text of character-ability-text.json and adds no rule; the card keeps the full text.

summaries.politics-dwarves-at-erebor: Any die in Erebor moves the Dwarves a step toward war
summaries.politics-gondor-at-city-or-stronghold: Any die in a Gondor City or Stronghold moves Gondor a step toward war
summaries.politics-elves-at-stronghold: Any die in an Elven Stronghold moves the Elves a step toward war
summaries.guide-draw-after-event-die-card: Draws a card after an Event played with an Event die
summaries.may-transform-to-white: Becomes Gandalf the White with a Will die once a Minion is in play
summaries.guide-hide-with-any-action-die: Any die hides a revealed Fellowship
summaries.may-transform-to-aragorn: Becomes Aragorn with a Will die in Minas Tirith, Dol Amroth or Pelargir
summaries.guide-separate-to-reduce-hunt-one: Separates to reduce Hunt damage by 1
summaries.return-after-fellowship-elimination-exce: Returns separated if eliminated in the Fellowship (not in Mordor)
summaries.move-four-alone-or-with-one-hobbit: Moves up to 4 regions alone or with one Hobbit
summaries.forfeit-leadership-to-cancel-nazgul-for-: Forfeits his Leadership to cancel all Nazgûl Leadership in a battle
summaries.enter-and-guide-when-no-companions: Joins the Fellowship when no Companions remain
summaries.ignore-standard-numbered-reveal: Ignores Reveal on standard numbered tiles
summaries.voluntary-reveal-to-reduce-hunt-one: Reveals the Fellowship to reduce Hunt damage by 1
summaries.add-gollum-when-no-companions: Gollum becomes Guide when no Companions remain
summaries.cannot-leave-orthanc: Never leaves Orthanc; may lead an attack from it
summaries.muster-each-isengard-settlement-or-upgra: Muster die: a Regular per Isengard Settlement, or upgrade 2 in Orthanc
summaries.isengard-elites-have-leadership: Isengard Elites also count as Leaders
summaries.muster-as-army-once-per-turn: Once per turn a Muster die acts as an Army die
summaries.entry-activates-all-free-peoples: Entering play activates every Free Peoples Nation
summaries.draw-after-first-round-combat-card: Draws a card if a Combat card was played in the first round
summaries.vilya: Gives Vilya to the Shadow to keep a used die and its result available
summaries.household-of-elrond: Elven Elites in his region count as Leaders in combat
summaries.combat-card-level-three: Counts as level 3 for Combat card effects
summaries.cannot-leave-rivendell: Never leaves Rivendell; removed if the Shadow conquers it
summaries.nenya: Gives Nenya to the Shadow to cancel a drawn standard Eye tile and redraw
summaries.valour-of-the-elven-people: May recruit in Lórien while it is besieged
summaries.cannot-leave-lorien: Never leaves Lórien; removed if the Shadow conquers it
summaries.narya: Gives Narya and any die to put his Settlement's Nation at war
summaries.guide-conditional-narya-die: As Guide, adds the Narya die when a Fellowship die returns from the Hunt
summaries.always-guide: The first Sméagol tile makes him the Guide; his tiles cause no damage
summaries.level-of-highest-other-companion: Level equals the highest other Companion's; may be a Hunt casualty
summaries.smeagol-departure: Leaves when separated, eliminated or declared at a FP City or Stronghold
summaries.fire-and-shadow: Extra Hunt tile in his region; an Eye on it eliminates him and the Guide
summaries.balrog-activation: Use Balrog activates him, or when active moves or attacks once
summaries.not-minion-for-gandalf-white: Does not count as a Minion for Gandalf the White's entry
summaries.fling-them-into-the-fray: Muster die: recruits or upgrades a Sauron Regular with his army
summaries.evil-knowledge: With a besieging army, extends one siege round without losing an Elite
summaries.great-sorcery: Once per turn a Muster die acts as a Character die for his army
summaries.spear-of-terror: Draws a Character card when playing a Character Event at the Fellowship
summaries.he-sees-he-knows: Moves without an action to the region where the Fellowship declares
summaries.champion-gondor: +1 Combat Strength in battles in Gondor or Osgiliath (max 5 dice)
summaries.messenger-gondor: Any die in a Gondor City or Stronghold activates and advances Gondor
summaries.movement-level-two: Counts as level 2 for movement only
summaries.champion-dwarves: +1 Combat Strength in battles in Dwarven regions (max 5 dice)
summaries.messenger-dwarves: Any die in Erebor activates and advances the Dwarves
summaries.fate.character.gimli-dwarven-lord#messen: Any die in Iron Hills or Ered Luin activates and advances the Dwarves
summaries.champion-elves: +1 Combat Strength in battles in Elven regions (max 5 dice)
summaries.prince-of-mirkwood: Any die in an Elven Stronghold moves the Elves a step toward war
summaries.guide-cancel-standard-hunt: As Guide, eliminates both Hobbits to cancel a standard Hunt tile
summaries.champion-north: +1 Combat Strength in battles in North regions (max 5 dice)
summaries.art-of-disappearing: Eliminated in battle, returns to an adjacent region
summaries.messenger-north: Any die in a North City activates and advances the North
summaries.guide-first-move-to-fellowship-box: As Guide, his first move's die goes to the Fellowship box, not the Hunt
summaries.heir-of-bard: Once per North battle, replaces your Combat card to cancel the Shadow's
summaries.call-to-arms: Ruler Muster or Will die: recruits three North Regulars or Leaders
summaries.corrupted-ruler: Blocks some Leader and Elite recruitment; cannot move or fight
summaries.shadows-in-the-north: Once per North battle, Shadow swaps its Combat card to cancel the FP one
summaries.dwarvenking: Muster in Erebor: upgrades a Dwarven Regular in his army to Elite
summaries.iron-guard: Ruler Muster or Will die: recruits two Dwarven units, one in his region
summaries.fate-of-the-lonely-mountain: Once per Erebor siege, Shadow may extend it by losing a Regular
summaries.stewardship: Muster in Minas Tirith: upgrades a Gondor Regular in his army to Elite
summaries.palantir-of-anarion: Ruler Event or Will die in Minas Tirith: an Event action, then one draw
summaries.fate-of-the-white-tower: Once per Minas Tirith siege, Shadow may extend it by losing a Regular
summaries.forth-eorlingas: Leadership 3 in a battle's first round, 1 in later rounds
summaries.mustering-of-the-mark: Ruler Muster or Will die: recruits three Rohan Regulars or Leaders
summaries.mark-of-the-white-hand: Helm's Deep held by the Shadow counts as an Isengard Stronghold
summaries.elvenking: Muster in Woodland Realm: upgrades an Elven Regular in his army to Elite
summaries.far-sighted: Ruler Character or Will die: one fewer Hunt die, or +1 Companion range
summaries.fate-of-mirkwood: Once per Woodland Realm siege, Shadow may extend it by losing a Regular
summaries.red-wrath: Trades your Combat card and a hit for +1 to Shadow Combat rolls
summaries.lord-of-the-bats: Trades your Combat card and his Leadership for +1 to Leader re-rolls
summaries.i-command: Replaces your Combat card: +1 to both armies' rolls and re-rolls
summaries.we-march-day-and-night: At or next to the Fellowship, +1 to every Shadow Hunt re-roll die
summaries.politics-dwarves-at-fate-homelands: Any die in Iron Hills or Ered Luin moves the Dwarves a step toward war
